content:
Parsewave builds coding datasets for leading AI research labs. We're looking for people with real Lean experience to design and validate hard, real-world Lean tasks used to train AI models.

If you work with Lean regularly, whether in research, formalization, or Mathlib contributions, this is a good fit.

Fully remote, worldwide. Freelance, flexible. No meetings, no minimum hours.

$80/task, $90 for excellent work. ~2-3 hrs average per task. Paid in USD.

Apply: https://parsewave.ai/apply-lean

You should hear back within 3-4 days.
Is "no meetings, no minimum hours" meant to be a positive or a negative?

Wrenna Robson said:

Is "no meetings, no minimum hours" meant to be a positive or a negative?

This is intended to be a positive, since most of our contributors are already working professionals who find their free time a scarce resource. Rest assured, we brief our first time contributors comprehensively through our tutorial videos, have a pretty easy submission platform and a very active support channel to help out if something is wrong.
Sadly working freelance in the UK is so complicated ;_;
Taxes scare me
According to the figures given above, this job would pay $45 per hour in the best case. I’ll leave it everyone to decide if this is a decent wage.

Wrenna Robson said:

Taxes scare me

Actually, we pay out using Wise and crypto as well, if you're into that.

Ching-Tsun Chou said:

According to the figures given above, this job would pay $45 per hour in the best case. I’ll leave it everyone to decide if this is a decent wage.

Yes, initially. We intend this to be a trial period, after a few tasks we intend to discuss a full time role with them with competitive pay. Most contributors do not make it through all the tasks they can possibly submit, but if they do, our team will reach out to them about this
